lead: `$x != null && $x->member()` does not compile in Novis, because `&&` does not narrow a nullable receiver for its right side.
body: `E0459` names the receiver as nullable, and a second `E0401` calls the member's result `mixed`, so the error reads like a type problem in the member. Test for `null` in its own `if` and do the call inside it, as `docs/examples/core/Http-TlsInfo/subject/03-checking-the-partner-organization.nvs` does.
